title: 12 Psychology Experiments You Can't Unsee (Long Listen)
desc: Twelve famous psychology experiments, told calmly and honestly: the marshmallow test, Asch's wrong-answer room, Milgram, the Bobo doll, Harlow's wire and cloth mothers, the bystander effect, Rosenhan's pseudo-patients, Pavlov and Little Albert, Ebbinghaus's forgetting curve, the Stanford basement, Festinger's one-dollar lie and Dunning-Kruger. For each: what was done, what was found, what critics later said and what you can use in daily life. A long, sourced listen for the evening.
